text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Three friends assembled for the new
year! A triple
first shrine visit!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I forgot to bring coins for my
offering!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can lend you some, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa and her friends are
starting their
senior year at last. I'm
accompanying the three of
them for
their first shrine visit of the new year.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. The arrow that person's
holding is a
hamaya, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I heard a story about those things!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
One arrow breaks easily, but three
arrows
together can break your enemy!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Three arrows? Perhaps you're thinking of
Mori's
lesson of the three arrows. But I
think you might
be misunderstanding
part of it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What's this three arrow business?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Basically, if the three of us work
together, we can
even beat Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! We're stronger together than
on our
own! Like a power up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the time being, it seems as though
the three
of them have the same
opponent to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang, clang!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can run with Suzuka and give a

performance everyone will talk about!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I swear to dedicate myself to my training
so I can
surpass Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I wanna beat Suzuka! I won't lose this
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each racer phrases it differently, but
they all have
one goal.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, after parting with Special Week
and Grass
Wonder...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. My first race of the new
year is the
Takarazuka Kinen, right? Will
Suzuka be running
there?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right! In that case, I gotta be fearless
and
resolute in my training until then!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, Spe, and Grass are all great
rivals, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think we should try to train
like for
our New Year's training session?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she wants to replicate one of their
training
styles. It's true that all three of
them have their
strong points.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The energetic Special Week. The
intelligent Grass
Wonder. The enigmatic
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to try to imitate one of
them,
maybe we should go with...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, so you think I should train like
Spe?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's only one thing that
comes to
mind!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe was born in Hokkaido, and she's real
good at
farming! Workin' in the fields
has gotta be great
exercise!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pull out some carrots, shake off the dirt,
and
then—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nom! Munch, munch! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Spe always gives 'em a taste!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That was one delicious carrot. I'm havin'
another! I
can eat as many as I want
guilt-free since I'm bein'
Spe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa eats every carrot in sight,
and
seems to have recovered a ton of
energy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! I don't eat that much!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, so you think I should train like
Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I remember Suzuka told me once that
she wants
to see a view where there's no
one else but her.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm gonna try to run and find a
place just
like that! See ya later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fsshhh...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There's no one here at the beach in the
offseason.
It's empty and beautiful...
but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so lonely! This isn't for me at all!
Traaaineeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa comes running back just
as
quickly as she left. Her experience
enduring
loneliness has helped her grow.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Training like G-Grass? I know her
training routine
well enough that...
Well...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It'll be tough, but if you think it's a good
idea...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today... I'm gonna study how to run.
Grass
doesn't skimp on running or
studying.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how boring it gets, it's
important that I
stay cool. Uuugh. I
really want to run, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Emulating Grass Wonder, she patiently
endures a
proper study session and
seems to learn many
new ways to
approach running.
